course_name_original: Ingeniería de los procesos de fabricación (106528)

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge and skills on different mechanical manufacturing methods and processes.
Determine any longitudinal or angular dimension that may arise in a section or verification laboratory of a mechanical industry.
Ensure that the parameters obtained are within the required quality.
Know metrology techniques and apparatus, as well as the quality control carried out in production processes.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and times and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to transmit concepts, ideas, processes, etc., related to Industrial Engineering orally and in writing, clearly and correctly.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for seeking sustainable engineering solutions.
Ability for teamwork and capacity for the development of multidisciplinary projects.
Ability to incorporate new knowledge in the area of Industrial Engineering, based on the acquired training and necessary for the evolution of technology.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology and quality control.

syllabus_topics: STUDY OF MACHINE TOOLS: fundamental movements. Cutting, feed and penetration movements.

CUTTING TOOL MATERIALS. Composition, applications, advantages and disadvantages of cutting tool materials. Steels, metallic carbides, cutting ceramics, diamond, coated materials, Cermet and new cutting materials.
GEOMETRY OF CUTTING TOOLS. Angles of cutting tools. Constant profile tools. Chip geometry. Shear plane. Chip breakers.
THEORY OF CUTTING SPEEDS. Cutting speed. Parameters influencing the choice of cutting speed. Taylor's theory; Choice of speeds from cutting tool manufacturer catalogs.
MACHINING PARAMETERS. Cutting forces. Specific cutting pressure by material removal. Cutting power and motor power. Cutting times. Machining time. Machine logbooks. Machining work process.
MEASURING INSTRUMENTS: direct linear and angular, analog and digital. Auxiliary and comparison measuring instruments.
TRIGONOMETRIC METROLOGY: measurement and verification of linear and angular magnitudes in prismatic and revolving (cones) parts.
teaching_methods: Practical classes in laboratories (guided practical activities)
Large group activities (exposition, explanation, examples, problem-solving by the professor)
Medium group activities (problem-solving and/or practical cases)
Evaluation tests (multiple-choice, short questions, practical and oral tests)

assessment_methods.method: Written exams of general knowledge and problem-solving

assessment_rules: The evaluation system will assess the acquisition of competencies, which must be demonstrated jointly through a continuous evaluation process and the increasing introduction of capacities and skills throughout the course. The criteria for assessment will be communicated in each case.
